title: Individuals Customer Experience and Perceptions Survey 2025
text:
The Individuals Customer Experience and Perceptions Survey supports  HMRC ’s customer-centric business strategy.

 The annual survey covers a broad range of measures, focusing on areas identified through analysis as priorities for HMRC ’s customers. The survey aims to:

 • understand and track changes in overall customer experience over time

 • understand and track changes in overall perceptions of  HMRC  over time

 • help  HMRC  identify where to target effort to improve customer experience and service

 This report presents the results from the 2025 annual survey for the Individuals customer group.
